Maria Chen: Quick thought—should we make routing pick region by 95th pct per-tenant latency instead of avg? We keep seeing outliers for EU tenants that push them to us-east even tho most reqs are fine.
Devon Patel: 95th makes sense for SLOs, but it can cause oscillation if probes are noisy. We should combine passive p95 with active probe smoothing (EWMA).
Liam O'Neil: also need to consider cost + KV cache affinity. If we move region we lose prefix cache hits -> higher token cost & latency.
Maria Chen: agreed. proposal: prefer local region if passive p95 < 120ms AND probe p95 < 150ms. else fallback to cross-region with hysteresis 10m.
Ava Gomez: UI ask: expose the thresholds per-customer tier in console (Enterprise vs Standard) + allow manual override and forced-variant fallback toggle.
Devon Patel: for model variant fallback: prefer quantized-8bit variant first, then smaller context variant, then cross-region. We need rules: prefer same-region + quantized if model semantically equivalent.
Liam O'Neil: quota implications: routing to quantized variant must still count to same model quota or we confuse billing dashboards. We need to tag telemetry with model_variant and routed_region.
infra-bot: Deploybot: canary rollout started for routing-policy v2 on eng-platform (build 2026.03.20.2) :rocket: 
Maria Chen: sample route config draft:
```
routing_policy:
  tiers:
    enterprise:
      prefer_local_p95_ms: 120
      probe_window_s: 60
      hysteresis_min: 600
      fallback_sequence: [same_region_quant8, same_region_smallctx, cross_region_same_variant]
```
Devon Patel: telemetry events to add: route_choice, passive_p95_ms, probe_p95_ms, fallback_reason, cache_hit_rate, model_variant_tag, ejection_count.
Ava Gomez: console panels: per-tenant map, last 24h route decisions, rollback button, realtime probe health, and 'simulate override' modal.
Liam O'Neil: also add a rate limit guard: don't send >5% of traffic cross-region in 1m without manual approval for tier Standard.
Maria Chen: cool. action items: Devon -> implement probe+EWMA; Liam -> quota tagging & cache metric; Ava -> console mockups; Maria -> update routing_policy schema. target: EOW for spec + next-week canary.
Devon Patel: will PR probe algorithm today :eyes: 
Ava Gomez: I'll sketch mockups and link in #product by EOD :art: 
Liam O'Neil: I'll add telemetry tags and a quick experiment to quantify cache loss.
Maria Chen: thanks team :thumbsup:
